sn21.6:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.6:1.2: atha kho āyasmā lakuṇṭaka bhaddiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā.
sn21.6:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ lakuṇṭakabhaddiyaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn21.6:1.5: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpanti.
sn21.6:1.7: eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā
sn21.6:1.8: yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
